periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation with the superior poles shifted laterally and inferior poles converging towards the midline at approximately 75-80 degrees from the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertical ovoid with an elongated major axis relative to the minor horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Notable downward extension below the ocular center, creating a teardrop-like taper towards the muzzle.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness; the band encompasses the entire shoulder region and extends down the visible forelimbs, covering roughly one-third of the visible body length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Substantial gap; ears are located on the far lateral-superior edges of the head.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Irregular curvature with slightly flattened/truncated apexes rather than uniform circular arcs.

other_distinctive_markers: Partial visibility of the lower dentition due to a slightly open mandibular posture.
